x: Tim Bayley ran a pb in the 1500 and Simon Marwood returned to the fold to gain an excellent third in the steeplechase. Darren Gauson had hoped for a fast time in the A 800 but a tactical first lap of 58 secs. put paid to that.

11 BMC Nike Grand Prix, Watford. 800m: 10rA P Owor 1:52.15; 2rB T Bayley 1:49.92; 6rB G Oudney 1:51.31; 3rC R Ashe 1:50.95. 1500m: 16rA S Sharp 3:45.96; 7rB D Gauson 3:47.3 (manual time); 8rD P Wicks 3:53.86; 12rE K Nash 4:00.70.

With Windsor’s James McIlroy in the field it was unlikely that anyone was tipping Tim Bayley as the 800 metres winner – but win he did – grabbing the lead while McIlroy faded, ultimately to drop out, and holding on grimly all the way to the finish.
